steps.gate: grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
steps.prompt_rendered:
Risks of fixing it this way: <summary of step 1 (explore)>

End your answer with one line, `RISK: LOW`, `RISK: MEDIUM` or `RISK: HIGH`.
Make the fix. Diagnosis: <summary of step 1 (explore)> Risks to keep in mind: <summary of step 2 (plan)>
Verify the fix: run the project's tests and report what passed and what failed. Problem: INPUT

steps.text: Step 1 runs the `explore` agent. It sees the workflow input. If it fails the workflow stops.

steps.gate: grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
steps.text: Step 2 runs the `plan` agent. It sees the summary of step 1 (explore). When it finishes, the command `grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0` runs and an exit status of 2 stops the workflow. If it fails the workflow stops.
Step 3 runs the `general` agent. It sees the summary of step 1 (explore) and the summary of step 2 (plan). If it fails the workflow stops.
Step 4 runs the `general` agent. It sees the workflow input. If it fails, step 3 and this one run again, at most 2 times.

structured.name: fix
structured.toml:
name = "fix"
description = "Diagnose, assess risk, fix, verify"

[[step]]
agent = "explore"
prompt = "Diagnose this problem and say where the cause is (file paths and line numbers): {{input}}"

[[step]]
agent = "plan"
prompt = """
Risks of fixing it this way: {{prev.summary}}

End your answer with one line, `RISK: LOW`, `RISK: MEDIUM` or `RISK: HIGH`.
"""
# Reads the step's JSON on stdin; exit 2 blocks the chain and stderr says why.
gate = '''grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0'''

[[step]]
agent = "general"
prompt = "Make the fix. Diagnosis: {{steps.explore.summary}} Risks to keep in mind: {{steps.plan.summary}}"

[[step]]
agent = "general"
prompt = "Verify the fix: run the project's tests and report what passed and what failed. Problem: {{input}}"
on_fail = "retry:2"

agent_list.description: List the agents a workflow step can name: built-in, project and user, with role, model and tools, and the skills of the project and the user.
agent_list.name: agent_list

workflow_dry_run.description: Show what a workflow would do for an input: each prompt rendered (a later step's summary is a placeholder), the gates, the agent each step resolves to and the budgets. No model is called and nothing runs.
workflow_dry_run.name: workflow_dry_run

workflow_explain.description: Say in plain words what each step of a workflow reads, what blocks it and how often it may retry, and list the data flow between steps (from 0 is the workflow input).
workflow_explain.name: workflow_explain

workflow_get.description: Read one workflow: the file text, its SHA-256 revision and the parsed steps. A broken file returns the parse error.
workflow_get.name: workflow_get

workflow_list.description: List the workflows of this project and of the user, with the parse error of any file that is broken.
workflow_list.name: workflow_list

workflow_validate.description: Check a workflow against the format and the real agent roster: either an existing one by name, or a draft as `toml` text. Nothing is saved.
workflow_validate.name: workflow_validate
